decision_table.name: Determine_MA_Filing_Requirement
decision_table.description: Determine if corporation must file MA state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

condition.name: has_physical_presence
condition.comment: Has physical presence in MA (office, employees, property)

actions.action: // Physical nexus established - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
MA filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in state).
Reference: MA Form 355 Instructions (Corporate Excise Tax Return) Reference: M.G.L. c. 63 § 39 (Corporate Excise Tax) Reference: MA Department of Revenue TIR 18-10 (Nexus Standards)

MA filing required due to economic nexus (post-Wayfair). Threshold: $500,000 in gross receipts from Massachusetts sources.
Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018) Reference: MA Department of Revenue TIR 18-10 (Economic Nexus) Reference: M.G.L. c. 63 § 1 (Definitions and nexus standards)
No MA nexus - no filing requirement. Any estimated payments would be refunded.

decision_table.name: Calculate_MA_Income_Adjustments
decision_table.description: Calculate MA state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments

rule.policy:
MA state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income.
Additions may include: - Interest on U.S. government obligations - IRC Section 199A qualified business income deduction - Safe harbor lease deductions - Accelerated depreciation differences (federal vs MA)
Subtractions may include: - Dividends from 15% or more owned subsidiaries (95% deduction) - Capital gains on certain qualified Massachusetts investments - Massachusetts net operating loss deduction
Reference: MA Form 355 Instructions (Lines 4-11) Reference: M.G.L. c. 63 § 30 (Deductions and adjustments) Reference: MA Department of Revenue TIR 05-15 (Dividend deduction)
No nexus - no state adjustments calculated.

decision_table.name: Calculate_MA_State_Tax
decision_table.description: Calculate MA state corporate excise tax. Applies 8% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to owe tax

rule.policy:
MA state corporate excise tax calculation:
1. Federal taxable income: [Form 1120 line 28] 2. Apportioned to MA: × [Single-sales apportionment %] 3. State additions: + [Federal interest, 199A addback, etc.] 4. State subtractions: - [Dividend deduction, qualified capital gains, NOL] 5. MA taxable income: = [Result] 6. MA tax rate: × 8.0% (flat rate) 7. MA excise tax: = [Tax before credits] 8. MA credits: - [EDIP, R&D, film, renewable energy credits] 9. MA tax liability: = [Final tax]
Reference: MA Form 355 Instructions (Corporate Excise Tax Return) Reference: M.G.L. c. 63 § 39 (Corporate excise tax - 8% rate) Reference: M.G.L. c. 63 § 38C (Single-sales factor apportionment) Reference: MA Department of Revenue TIR 11-12 (Tax credits)
No MA nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded.

No MA taxable income - no tax liability. MA NOL carryforward rules may apply (limited to certain tax years).
Reference: M.G.L. c. 63 § 30.4 (Net operating loss deduction)
